# nlohmann/json

Vendored, unmodified single header and MIT license from version **3.12.0**:

- https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT
- `json.hpp` SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`

Used privately by `loom_io`. No network access or system JSON package is needed
to configure, build, or run Loom. JSON syntax is parsed by this library; Loom
decodes its experimental schema and reuses the existing plan validators.
